regions.region: page 1 title, authors, abstract, and graphical abstract
regions.finding: Verified the article title and aggregate current Cu/photoredox 1,4-arylcyanation class. The graphical abstract's 41-example statement is aggregate evidence for the general scheme, not 41 extra experiments.

regions.region: page 1 Figure 1 natural products and drugs
regions.finding: The six displayed allene-containing natural products/drug-like molecules are structural context only; no reaction arrow, condition, or current-paper preparation is present.
Classified Bao/Liu, Chen/Huang, Yao/He, and other radical methods as prior-literature context linked to Scheme 1A on page 2; external cited work was not promoted to current-paper experiments.

unresolved: Graphical-abstract/current-generic structures contain R groups and do not define experiment-specific charges or outcomes.
Supporting Information is advertised but workspace association is unestablished.

regions.finding: Visually separated four prior-literature reaction classes from the authors' current work. These are literature/general records and are not assigned current-paper scope yields.

regions.region: page 2 upper-left Scheme 1B current design and proposed pathway
regions.finding: Classified the current generic arylcyanation separately from the proposed SET/radical/copper pathway; propargyl/allenyl radicals and copper intermediates are not isolated preparations.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Table 1 reaction header, entries 1-18, and footnotes
regions.finding: Recorded all eighteen optimization/control rows independently with shared charges/conditions and every omission, loading, catalyst, solvent, temperature/light, ratio, and isolated-yield override applied row-wise. Entry 8 retains only its printed ratio because absolute charges are not defined.

Mapped 36 W blue-light wording, component-omission conclusions, and solvent/catalyst comparisons to the existing Table 1 rows without creating narrative duplicates. SI screening details were not inferred.

unresolved: Table 1 omits workup, purification, product masses, photochemical temperature, and trace detection limits.
Entry 8 prints a ratio but no absolute charge denominator.

regions.region: page 3 left Scheme 2 header, products 4a-4v, X-ray inset, and footnotes
regions.finding: Merged standard 4a/50% with Table 1 entry 1; recorded the distinct 1.0 mmol 4a/45% run and every other 4b-4v product arrow independently. Shared charges/loadings/solvent/Ar/48 h/blue-light conditions and CCDC 2464619 for 4s were retained.

regions.region: page 3 right-column Scheme 2 and Scheme 3 scope prose
regions.finding: Mapped product ranges and substituent descriptions to the individual Scheme 2/3 records without duplicating rows or inventing compact structures.
Linked the four independent 4a/4f transformations to the page-4 arrows. The expected allenic amide failure and alkene-amide side product 9 remain separate outcomes.
Linked the TEMPO inhibition and 4-equivalent 1,1-diphenylethylene trapping experiment to Scheme 5 on page 4. Product 11 is explicitly isolated in 80% yield.

unresolved: Scope workups, purifications, isolated masses, and reaction temperatures are not printed.
Compact scope structures remain source-labeled where safe full encoding was uncertain.
The scale-up caption does not provide additional operational details.

regions.region: page 4 left Scheme 3 products 5a-5u and caption
regions.finding: Recorded all twenty-one distinct enyne/aryl-DBT scope arrows with exact isolated yields and shared displayed standard conditions; page-3 prose is merged as cross-page evidence.

Recorded four independent transformations: 4a->6, 6->7, 7->8, and 4f->9. Every displayed equivalent, solvent, atmosphere, temperature, time, and isolated yield is structured; 9 is not misassigned as the failed expected allenic amide.
Recorded the TEMPO 2-equivalent control (4a 8%) and the 1,1-diphenylethylene 4-equivalent trapping experiment (11, isolated 80%) separately. Scheme 5b does not depict enyne 1a, so none was inferred.

regions.region: page 4 lower-right Scheme 6 reaction header and on/off graph
regions.finding: Recorded one ordered light-on/off time series with six displayed intervals and product-4i yields at 20/24/32/36/44/48 h of 30/30/36/36/42/42%. Dark holds are separate timed steps.
The conclusion restates the current reaction class and adds no experiment-specific arrow, charge, condition, or yield.

unresolved: Scheme 4/5 omit several absolute charges, solvent volumes, workups, purifications, masses, and some yield bases.
Scheme 6 omits reactant charges, photochemical temperature, and yield measurement basis.
